_comment: Plus Jakarta Sans, the typeface of the VaxLink walkthrough, self-hosted for the journeys viewer's presentation pages (owner, 2026-11-05: vendored, no CDN, no npm). Only the five upright weights VaxLink loads (400 Regular, 500 Medium, 600 SemiBold, 700 Bold, 800 ExtraBold). Taken from the upstream repository at tag 2.7.1, whose release assets carry no webfonts: each .woff2 is the tag's static TTF re-wrapped losslessly as WOFF2 by fontTools 4.60.1 (fontTools.ttLib.woff2.compress, brotli 1.1.0), which gives the same bytes on every run; the glyphs and tables are the TTF's. OFL.txt is the upstream file, unmodified.
